steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Two events are mutually exclusive if they cannot happen at the same time. If one happens, the other cannot.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: A dice is rolled. Are "rolling an even number" and "rolling a 6" mutually exclusive? | A bag has 5 red, 3 blue and 2 yellow balls. Find P(red or yellow). | P(A) = 0.4, P(B) = 0.35. If A and B are mutually exclusive, find P(A or B).

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: A dice is rolled. Let A = "even number" and B = "number greater than 4". (a) Are A and B mutually exclusive? Justify your answer. (b) Find P(A), P(B), and P(A ∩ B). (c) Use the formula P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B) to find P(A or B). <div class="
